SELECT goods_spu.`id`, goods_spu.`name`, goods_spu.`sub_title`, goods_spu.`spu_urls`, goods_spu.`status`, goods_spu.`stock`, goods_spu.`sales_price`, goods_spu.`original_price`, goods_spu.`is_member_item`, goods_spu.`member_discount_rate`, goods_spu.`member_price_fixed`, goods_spu.`member_price_floor`, goods_spu.`is_clearance_item`, goods_spu.`clearance_price`, goods_spu.`clearance_discount_rate`, goods_spu.`clearance_expire_time`, goods_spu.`category_second_id`, goods_spu.`brand_id`, goods_category.`name` AS category_name, goods_brand.`name` AS brand_name FROM goods_spu AS goods_spu LEFT JOIN goods_category AS goods_category ON goods_spu.`category_second_id` = goods_category.`id` LEFT JOIN goods_brand AS goods_brand ON goods_spu.`brand_id` = goods_brand.`id` WHERE goods_spu.`del_flag` = '0'
ORDER BY goods_spu.`id` ASC
